newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador prices rise 0.1 pct during October.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador prices rise 0.1 pct during October.

text.p: Prices in El Salvador rose 0.1 percent during October after falling 0.6 percent the previous month, the Economy Ministry said on Tuesday.
Accumulated inflation for the first 10 months of the year was 7.7 percent, compared with 10.3 percent during the same period last year.
Prices rose 8.3 percent in the 12 months to the end of October.
Central bank President Roberto Orellana told reporters the government was confident it would meet its 1996 inflation target of between 8.5 and 9.0 percent.
